notes: ACCESS: Shopify storefront, reached by plain direct requests fetches via probe.py - no proxy, no blocking, matching the prior Home-Decor pass on this SR. TREE: taken from the server-rendered mega-menu in the homepage HTML, which exposes an explicit three-tier structure (header__main-nav-item / mega-menu__tier-2-list-item / mega-menu__tier-3-list-item). Furniture lives in five room departments - Outdoor, Living, Dining, Bedroom, Office - with no single Furniture department; Lighting and Decor are the other two departments and are out of scope. Every tier-3 node was fetched and walked; tier-3 is the deepest level, below it are only sort/filter facets which are excluded as filter pages. QTY: every PLP server-renders its own total twice - a bare 'N items' badge and 'Showing 1 to N of N items'. Both strings agreed on all 41 leaves. Each leaf was then independently cross-checked by enumerating /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 and counting unique product handles; all 41 matched the rendered header exactly, so the rendered header is confirmed authoritative here. platform-beds initially returned a truncated body with no header; it was re-read three times and was stable at 12, matching its 12 JSON handles. SANITY CHECKS: the h1 of every fetched page matched the intended node, so no page silently served a parent listing. Counts vary correctly per category (2 to 42), none is a round display cap, and repeat reads agreed. Parent roll-ups are NOT sums of their children on this site (Living Seating 110 vs children 38+14+32+28=112; Outdoor Seating 61 vs children 57; Bedroom Storage 58 vs children 19+42+15=76), so no parent number was used or derived - every parent is emitted as a grouping row with qty null per the hierarchy rule. EXCLUDED AS NON-LISTING PAGES: 'Dining Room Furniture Sets' (/collections/dining-room-furniture-sets) and 'Bedroom Furniture Sets' (/collections/bedroom-furniture-sets) look like furniture-set categories but are empty Shopify collections - products.json returns 0 for both, they render no product grid, no facet toolbar and no count, and their assembled carousels mix in pendant lights. They are SEO landing pages, so they were dropped rather than emitted with a null qty. Also dropped per the navigation-junk rule: every 'View All' node (modern-outdoor/living/dining/bedroom/office-furniture-all, living-seating, tables-storage, outdoor-seating, outdoor-tables, seating, all-dining-tables, workstations, office-seating, modern-beds, storage, dining-storage-organization, office-storage-organization - these are the parents and are emitted as grouping rows instead), plus Collections, Bestsellers, In Stock, New to Sale, Last Chance and all Sale nodes. EXCLUDED ON PRODUCT TYPE, with titles inspected via products.json rather than guessed: 'Coat Racks + Hooks' (12 - six are wall hooks or a wall shelf, the rest are coat racks, a garment rack and the Garden Party wardrobe/shelving systems, so not primarily furniture; the wardrobe system is already captured under Office > Storage + Cabinets). 'Organization' (36 - storage baskets, trays, bowls, an organizer tray and a shoe rack; standalone storage goods, out of scope here). 'Closet Storage' (15 - 9 of 15 are wall hooks, felt/storage baskets and a storage box; only the Shale Wardrobe, the Garden Party wardrobe/shelving/garment systems and a step stool are furniture, so the primary product type is storage goods). Office > 'Entryway' (62) - a cross-department roll-up that reproduces Living > Entryway (60) and mixes roughly 40 furniture pieces with roughly 21 bowls, trays, baskets, hooks, boxes and a wastebasket; its furniture is already covered by the Benches, Shelving + Bookcases, Console/Media Consoles and Storage + Cabinets leaves, so it was dropped to avoid a mixed double count. 'Office Accessories' (45) excluded as accessories. 'Mattresses' (3, under Bedroom > Beds) excluded per the brief. All Decor + Accessories, Rugs, Pillows + Throws, Bedding, Mirrors, Art, Outdoor Pillows, Outdoor Accessories and the entire Lighting and Decor departments excluded as out of scope. DEDUPE: Office > Seating > 'Benches' is the identical URL /collections/entry-benches as Living > Entryway > 'Benches', so it is emitted once, under Entryway. KEPT BUT OVERLAPPING, flagged individually: Work Tables vs Conference; Office Lounge Chairs (accent-chairs) vs Lounge Chairs; Platform Beds vs its parent Beds view-all. Also noted: /collections/all-dining-tables returns exactly the same 23 handles as /collections/dining-tables - all-dining-tables is the 'View All' parent and is emitted as the grouping row 'All Dining Tables'.
